name: vscode-claude-toasts
description: Native desktop notifications when Claude Code finishes a turn or needs your input, driven by Claude Code hooks.

claudeToasts.enabled.description: Master switch. When off, no toasts are shown.

claudeToasts.notifyOnComplete.description: Show a toast when Claude finishes a turn (Stop hook).

claudeToasts.notifyOnNeedsInput.description: Show a toast when Claude is blocked waiting on you (permission prompt, idle, or needs input).

claudeToasts.minTurnDurationSeconds.description: Do not show a completion toast for turns shorter than this many seconds.

claudeToasts.suppressWhenActiveTerminal.description: Stay quiet when the window is focused and you are already looking at the terminal running that session.

claudeToasts.messagePreviewLength.description: How many characters of Claude's message to show in the toast body (max 500).

claudeToasts.sound.description: Play the system notification sound with each toast.

claudeToasts.dedupWindowSeconds.description: Collapse repeat toasts for the same session and kind within this many seconds.

claudeToasts.maxToastsPerMinute.description: Runaway backstop: never show more than this many toasts per minute.
